Proposition
[The metric and volume form are parallel]

Source: petersen:page-0076 ↗ def:pet-ch2-parallel-tensor

1. ch2:2.2.5On a Riemannian $n$-manifold, $ abla g=0$ and $ abla \mathrm{vol}=0$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-metric-volume-parallel

\sketch Metric compatibility is precisely $ abla g=0$. For an oriented orthonormal frame,

\[ ( abla _X\mathrm{vol})(E_1,\dots ,E_n) =-\sum _i\mathrm{vol}(E_1,\dots , abla _XE_i,\dots ,E_n) =-\sum _i g( abla _XE_i,E_i)=0, \]

because each $g(E_i,E_i)$ is constant.

□
